about: Reliance Power Ltd is the listed holding company of a power-generation group operating 5,305 MW: 5,160 MW thermal and 145 MW renewable. Its main assets are the 3,960 MW Sasan UMPP, 1,200 MW Rosa plant, 40 MW solar PV, 100 MW concentrated-solar and 5 MW wind projects; Reliance NU subsidiaries are developing solar-plus-storage projects.
